crossRefs.note: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
All the offspring of Israel will be justified in Yahweh, and will rejoice!
But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving…
Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,
that no flesh should boast before God.
Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

translations.web: In God we have made our boast all day long, we will give thanks to your name forever.
translations.bsb: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
translations.kjv: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
translations.asv: In God have we made our boast all the day long, And we will give thanks unto thy name for ever. Selah
